# Rork

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dark AI-builder marketing: near-black page, white pill sign-in, a 28px composer card, and an orange Max plan.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public pages and the sign-in dialog; email was not submitted and OAuth was not entered). Themes: dark.

Rork is an AI app builder for iOS, Android, and web (rork.com). This package captures the public marketing site and the signed-out sign-in dialog. No account was created.

Surfaces: home, pricing dialog, FAQ, blog, Max, founders, and reviews, plus the sign-in dialog opened from the home page. Theme: dark only. Widths: 1440 and 390 CSS pixels. Captured 19 November 2026.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.

- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The page colour is `#171717`, not pure black. Several surfaces are the same colour at an opacity (`bg-background/80`, white at 4% and 8%). Those are recorded as 8-digit hex.

Britti Sans is in the computed font stack and was not loaded (`document.fonts.check` returned false). Headlines painted with the system face ahead of it. FAQ headings name Britti Sans first, so they painted the fallback (Roboto, then Arial) in this browser.

The Sign in radius computed as `3.35544e+07px`. That is a pill. The token records `9999px`.

The App nav word is a text gradient (`#ffd230` to `#ff6900`). Its computed `color` is transparent. Do not read the word as black.

The providers screenshot and the email screenshot are the same dialog at two steps. The email field's focus ring was read, and the Sign in button's keyboard focus ring was read. Pressed, disabled, and loading were not on screen.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page at #171717.** The body background is `rgb(23, 23, 23)`, and the text is white. [home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
- **Use white pills for the primary action.** Sign in is a white pill, 36px tall, with black 14px medium type. [button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png)
- **Put the prompt in a 28px card.** The composer is `#262626`, 768px wide, radius 28px. [text-field-composer-default.png](components/crops/text-field-composer-default.png)
- **Reserve the orange gradient for Rork Max.** The Max plan card runs from `#e17100` to `#ca3500`. Free and Pro sit on a 4% white wash. [card-max-default.png](components/crops/card-max-default.png)
- **Do not send the email step.** The dialog says it will email a 6-digit code. That request was not made. [login-dark-email.png](screenshots/login-dark-email.png)
